policy.method: public web/search metadata and public pages only
policy.engagementRule: Only directly visible/verifiable engagement is canonical; secondary or absent values remain non-canonical/null.

candidates.title: Indian police say network managed more than 500,000 fake Gmail accounts in bomb-hoax case
candidates.whyItMayWork: The unusually large account count creates a clear cybersecurity hook with public-interest relevance.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Crime allegations require careful attribution; avoid operational detail, sensationalism or implying guilt beyond reported claims.

candidates.title: Micron Taiwan union presses permanent profit-sharing demand while strike preparations remain alive
candidates.whyItMayWork: AI-chip demand meets worker compensation and possible supply disruption, crossing career and semiconductor audiences.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Negotiations are active and can change quickly; claims and deadlines need a fresh check before production.

candidates.title: Bitcoin late-summer rally faces a Fed and Congress test
candidates.whyItMayWork: A simple catalyst checklist can connect crypto momentum with this week's macro and policy events.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Price-sensitive topic; must timestamp all market data and avoid investment recommendations.

candidates.title: Airbus says it sees no softening in aircraft demand despite geopolitical headwinds
candidates.whyItMayWork: A counter-intuitive resilient-demand angle works as a short business explainer beyond the usual AI/market feed.
candidates.whyItMayBeWeak: Less inherently social than community stories and may need a stronger comparison or chart before production.
